games.title: Packet Quest: The Great Outage
games.description: A retro RPG where every battle is a question. Fight through nine zones of CCNA / Network+ networking, Linux, Git & CI/CD, network automation, containers and IaC, with spaced repetition, a Codex, daily quests and a two-player Quiz Duel.
